title: Recheck whether Palaver is still sold (client-survey.md §11, §2)
description:
client-survey.md §11's first Uncertainties entry and the §2 client table both record, dated 2026-11-21, that Palaver (iOS, closed) may no longer be sold: the iTunes lookup for id 538073623 returned no result in three stores, the store page 404s and palaverapp.com has an expired certificate; last version seen 2.10.3, 2024. §2 step 8 (the palaverapp.com cap, PALAVER command set, znc.in/playback) is conditioned on 'Only if Palaver is still sold'.

An app store cannot be checked from the agent's offline environment, so a human has to look. If Palaver is gone, drop step 8 and the Palaver rows; if it is still sold, say so in §11 and date it.
